exposure: maternal intake of 32 nutrients during pregnancy
outcome: acute leukemia in children under 2 years old
cohort: 110 cases of acute leukemia in children under 2 years old and 252 hospital-based controls in the Mexico City Metropolitan area from 2010 to 2019.
finding: A specific combination of maternal nutrient intake during pregnancy was negatively associated with acute leukemia in girls, but not in boys.
